candidates.name: abb
candidates.description: abb is a technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. the company’s solutions connect engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered and operated. building on over 140 years of excellence, abb’s more than 110,000 employees are committed to driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.  www.abb.comprivacy notice & house rules: https://social.abb/social-media-informationbefore applying for a job at abb, please read our fraud warning: https://careers.abb/global/en/fraud-warning
candidates.rationale: Candidate is the same ABB entity, not a distinct lookalike company.

candidates.name: alpitronic
candidates.description: leading the way in development and deployment of efficient, reliable, dc fast-charging technology, alpitronic is driven to shape a sustainable, electric future.
candidates.rationale: Both provide DC fast-charging infrastructure for electric vehicles, targeting charging-network operators and commercial infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: chargepoint
candidates.description: electric mobility is the smart choice. we make it the easy one, too. so easy that someone plugs into our network every 1 second. since 2007, we’ve focused solely on building the best electric vehicle (ev) charging experience for everyone involved in the shift to electric.
candidates.rationale: ChargePoint and ABB both provide commercial EV charging infrastructure and software, serving fleet operators, businesses, and charging-network buyers.

candidates.name: evbox
candidates.description: evbox is a global leader in electric vehicle charging solutions.founded in 2007 and based in léognan, near bordeaux, evbox designs, manufactures, and distributes smart and scalable charging stations, along with management software solutions tailored for businesses.a pioneer in the field of fast charging (dc), evbox has over 18 years of industrial expertise in this sector, with more than 7,000 dc charging points installed across europe. the company relies on a strong capacity for innovation, driven by a particularly dynamic r&d department: 40% of its employees are dedicated to research and development.evbox plays a key role in the development of a reliable and sustainable charging infrastructure, supporting the energy transition at a european scale. its 300 m² laboratory and production site in léognan reflect this concrete commitment to innovation, both in hardware and software, as well as in the development of value-added services.our mission is clear: to accelerate the electrification of transport by providing high-performance, sustainable, and user-friendly charging technologies. we continuously innovate to meet the demands of a rapidly growing market, while ensuring high standards of quality, safety, and sustainability.
candidates.rationale: Both provide commercial EV charging hardware and management software for businesses building and operating electrified transport infrastructure.

candidates.name: evgo
candidates.description: evgo (nasdaq: evgo) is one of the nation’s leading public fast charging providers. with more than 1,100 fast charging stations across 40 states, evgo strategically deploys localized and accessible charging infrastructure by partnering with leading businesses across the u.s., including retailers, grocery stores, restaurants, shopping centers, gas stations, rideshare operators, and autonomous vehicle companies. at its dedicated innovation lab, evgo performs extensive interoperability testing and has ongoing technical collaborations with leading automakers and industry partners to advance the ev charging industry and deliver a seamless charging experience.   to find out more, or to join the evgo network, visit evgo.com.
candidates.rationale: EVgo operates a public EV charging network, while ABB primarily supplies industrial electrification and automation equipment, potentially to charging-network operators.

candidates.name: fastned
candidates.description: we are a group of ambitious, passionate people, driven to accelerate the energy transition and improve sustainable mobility. we currently have a network of 350+ reliable fast charging stations along highways, inside cities, and across prime european locations, completely powered by renewable energy and good vibes. our passion for electric mobility is charged with our mission and responsibility to reduce our carbon emissions and combat climate change. we are proud to be b-corp certified and actively combine sustainability with fast charging in every part of our business. as you scroll down our linkedin page, you'll get a taste of the company behind the canopy and learn more about who we are through business updates, company reports, and team testimonies. if you like what you see, or you want to be a part of fastned, drop us a message or check out our career page to learn more. see you there 👋
candidates.rationale: Fastned operates an EV charging network, while ABB supplies industrial electrification and automation technology; Fastned is more likely a customer than a competitor.

candidates.name: ionity
candidates.description: ionity makes long-distance travel with electric vehicles the new normal.the company builds and operates a high power charging (hpc) network along europe’s highways, using state-of-the-art technology with a charging capacity of up to 400kw. ionity adopts the leading european charging standard, ccs (combined charging system), ensuring that drivers of current and future evs can charge at maximum speed. each ionity station typically features four charging points. committed to sustainability, ionity powers all chargers with 100% renewable energy, enabling emission-free and carbon-neutral driving. ionity is a joint venture of the car manufacturers bmw group, ford motor company, hyundai motor group, mercedes benz ag and volkswagen group with audi and porsche, along with blackrocks climate infrastructure platform as financial investor. more than 200 employees are shaping the future of e-mobility at ionity. the company is headquartered in munich with an additional offices in dortmund, germany and oslo, norway. ionity is an internationally registered trademark. data privacy: https://www.ionity.eu/policies/privacyimprint: https://ionity.eu/en/imprint
candidates.rationale: IONITY operates an EV charging network, while ABB manufactures electrification and industrial automation technologies; IONITY is more likely an ABB customer than competitor.

candidates.name: kempower
candidates.description: we design and manufacture reliable and user-friendly dc fast-charging solutions for electric vehicles. our vision is to create the world’s most desired ev charging solutions for everyone, everywhere. our product development and production are based in finland and in the u.s., with the majority of our materials and components sourced locally. we focus on all areas of e-mobility, from electric cars, trucks, and buses to machines and marine. our modular and scalable charging systems and world-class software are designed by ev drivers for ev drivers, enabling the best user experience for our customers around the world. kempower shares are listed on nasdaq helsinki ltd. kempower.com
candidates.rationale: Kempower’s DC fast-charging systems directly overlap ABB’s EV charging and electrification offerings, targeting the same fleet, transit, and charging-infrastructure buyers.

candidates.name: schneider electric
candidates.description: schneider electric is a global energy technology leader, driving efficiency and sustainability by electrifying, automating, and digitalizing industries, businesses, and homes. its technologies enable buildings, data centers, factories, infrastructure, and grids to operate as open, interconnected ecosystems—enhancing performance, resilience, and sustainability. the portfolio includes intelligent devices, software-defined architectures, ai-powered systems, digital services, and expert advisory. with 160,000 employees and one million partners in over 100 countries, schneider electric is consistently ranked among the world’s most sustainable companies.  www.se.com follow us on:https://www.facebook.com/schneiderelectrichttps://www.x.com/schneiderelechttps://www.x.com/se_careershttps://www.instagram.com/schneiderelectrichttps://www.youtube.com/schneiderelectrichttps://www.tiktok.com/@schneiderelectric_global
candidates.rationale: Both provide industrial electrification, automation, digital energy management, and control technologies to factories, infrastructure, buildings, and utilities.

candidates.name: siemens
candidates.description: siemens ag (berlin and munich) is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, mobility, and healthcare. the company’s purpose is to create technology to transform the everyday, for everyone. by combining the real and the digital worlds, siemens empowers customers to accelerate their digital and sustainability transformations, making factories more efficient, cities more livable, and transportation more sustainable. a leader in industrial ai, siemens leverages its deep domain know-how to apply ai – including generative ai – to real-world applications, making ai accessible and impactful for customers across diverse industries. siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company siemens healthineers, a leading global medical technology provider pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. for everyone. everywhere. sustainably. in fiscal 2025, which ended on september 30, 2025, the siemens group generated revenue of €78.9 billion and net income of €10.4 billion. as of september 30, 2025, the company employed around 318,000 people worldwide on the basis of continuing operations.
candidates.rationale: Siemens directly overlaps ABB in industrial automation, electrification, motion, and digital manufacturing, serving the same industrial buyers and use cases.
